controls.name: C-21d
controls.query:
FROM logs-keycloak.events-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-07T05:45:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-07T06:55:00.000Z"
  AND loggerName == "org.keycloak.events"
  AND message LIKE "*type=\"LOGIN_ERROR\"*"
| GROK message "%{DATA}username=\"%{DATA:username}\"%{DATA}"
| GROK message "%{DATA}clientId=\"%{DATA:client_id}\"%{DATA}"
| STATS count = COUNT(*),
        first_seen = MIN(@timestamp),
        last_seen = MAX(@timestamp)
  BY username, client_id
| SORT count DESC
